def durable_inventory(directory):
    """One new QML only; runtime/template and PC proof files are outside device."""
    directory(DURABLE_ROOT)
    directory(DURABLE_ROOT / 'mta')
    for relative, expected in (('', {'mta'}), ('mta', {'MtaPage.qml'})):
        root = DURABLE_ROOT if relative == '' else DURABLE_ROOT / relative
        found = set()
        with os.scandir(root) as names:
            for count, entry in enumerate(names):
                require(count < 4, 'durable_inventory_budget')
                value = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                require(not stat.S_ISLNK(value.st_mode) and
                        not getattr(value, 'st_file_attributes', 0) & 0x400, 'durable_inventory_link')
                require(entry.name in expected and entry.name not in found and
                        (stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) if relative == '' else stat.S_ISREG(value.st_mode)),
                        'durable_inventory_extra')
                found.add(entry.name)
        require(found == expected, 'durable_inventory_incomplete')


def frozen_gui_inputs(read, directory):
    """Read the actual old GUI20, not a fixture or a newly claimed runtime pass."""
    stage_raw = read(OLD_BUNDLE / 'stage-manifest.json', *OLD_STAGE_PIN)
    result_raw = read(OLD_BUNDLE / 'build-result.json', *OLD_RESULT_PIN)
    stage, result = json.loads(stage_raw.decode('ascii')), json.loads(result_raw.decode('ascii'))
    require(stage['schema'] == 'p011-formal-receive-filecenter-navigation-gui-v1-stage' and
            stage['session'] == 'a87de5c1d0e0b90b35bb2a91' and
            stage['remote'] == '/mnt/data/p011-toolbox/mta-ui/' + stage['session'] and
            stage['navigation_argument'] == NAVIGATION_ARGUMENT and
            stage['payload_file_count'] == 19 and stage['staged_file_count'] == 20 and
            stage['directories'] == [dict(path=name, mode='0700') for name in ('', 'mta', 'toolbox')] and
            stage['excluded_pc_files'] == ['NaviPanel.embedded.qml', 'stage-manifest.json', 'build-result.json'],
            'frozen_gui_identity')
    require(result['builder_bytes'] == PARENT_BUILDER_PIN[0] and
            result['builder_sha256'] == PARENT_BUILDER_PIN[1] and
            result['source_ui_files'] == 17 and result['planned_stage_bytes'] == 4191494 and
            result['source_text_bytes'] == 85852, 'frozen_gui_result')
    files, pins = {}, []
    for row in stage['files']:
        name = row['path']
        require(type(name) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,128}', name) is not None and
                not PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() and
                all(part not in ('', '.', '..') for part in name.split('/')) and name not in files and
                row['mode'] == ('0500' if name == 'Z03.mta-ui-candidate' else '0400'), 'frozen_gui_file')
        files[name] = read(OLD_BUNDLE / name, row['bytes'], row['sha256'])
        pins.append((name, row['bytes'], row['sha256']))
    require(len(files) == 20 and 'SOURCE.sha256' in files and
            sum(len(raw) for raw in files.values()) == 4191494 and
            (len(files['SOURCE.sha256']), hashlib.sha256(files['SOURCE.sha256']).hexdigest()) ==
                (1691, '0227be7f467e24b2150efba70a52be5607ece0a8a8d757dfc0bdcc6be77aae98'),
            'frozen_gui_payload')
    payload_pins = sorted(row for row in pins if row[0] != 'SOURCE.sha256')
    expected = ''.join(sha + ' ' + str(size) + ' ' + name + '\n'
                       for name, size, sha in payload_pins).encode('ascii')
    require(files['SOURCE.sha256'] == expected and
            (len(files['mta/MtaPage.qml']), hashlib.sha256(files['mta/MtaPage.qml']).hexdigest()) ==
                (27441, '6f87bdfc8e3b00a85642dd849963219962c47b563d71bf65c291d1e73bcb77b2'),
            'frozen_gui_manifest')
    for relative in ('', 'mta', 'toolbox'):
        root = OLD_BUNDLE if relative == '' else OLD_BUNDLE / relative
        directory(root)
        wanted = {str(PurePosixPath(name).name) for name in files
                  if ('' if str(PurePosixPath(name).parent) == '.' else str(PurePosixPath(name).parent)) == relative}
        if relative == '':
            wanted.update(('mta', 'toolbox') + tuple(stage['excluded_pc_files']))
        found = set()
        with os.scandir(root) as names:
            for count, entry in enumerate(names):
                require(count < 32, 'frozen_gui_inventory_budget')
                value = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                is_directory = relative == '' and entry.name in ('mta', 'toolbox')
                require(entry.name in wanted and entry.name not in found and
                        not stat.S_ISLNK(value.st_mode) and
                        not getattr(value, 'st_file_attributes', 0) & 0x400 and
                        (stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) if is_directory else stat.S_ISREG(value.st_mode)),
                        'frozen_gui_inventory')
                found.add(entry.name)
        require(found == wanted, 'frozen_gui_inventory_incomplete')
    return dict(stage_raw=stage_raw, result_raw=result_raw, files=files)
